crossRefs.note: You shall take seven pairs of every clean animal with you, the male and his female. Of the animals that are not clean…
Also of the birds of the sky, seven and seven, male and female, to keep seed alive on the surface of all the earth.
Clean animals, unclean animals, birds, and everything that creeps on the ground
went by pairs to Noah into the ship, male and female, as God commanded Noah.

parallels.note: wild animals and all livestock; small creatures and flying birds;

translations.web: they, and every animal after its kind, all the livestock after their kind, every creeping thing that creeps on the earth after its kind, and every bird after its kind, every bird of every sort.
translations.bsb: they and every kind of wild animal, livestock, crawling creature, bird, and winged creature.
translations.kjv: They, and every beast after his kind, and all the cattle after their kind, and every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth after his kind, and every fowl after his kind, every bird of every sort.
translations.asv: they, and every beast after its kind, and all the cattle after their kind, and every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth after its kind, and every bird after its kind, every bird of every sort.
